marks.conclusion: An RL/imitation MLP (presumably ReLU) controlling an agent in a 10x10 gridworld with walls, an optional symmetric obstacle layout and a right-wall flag; 5 outputs most plausibly stay plus 4 moves.
marks.judge_notes: Channels credited: ch3 wall only. ch0 'most likely the agent' and ch2 'plausibly a goal or pickup' are both listed under 'main uncertainties' (exact meaning of ch0, 1, 2, 4), so they are not credited. Number of tasks: 2, reply said 'levels' ('two map variants'/'2 maps'). Actions 1: moves read from gridworld structure; it guessed 'output 4 is likely stay/no-op' (wrong; no-op is output 0) but hedged with 'likely', so not deducted, and it gives no correct assignment. It says outputs 1 and 2 are opposing; they are up/down, but it only called them 'e.g. left vs right', so no credit. Depth level 1: veto units h16->out3 etc. are listed with no first-layer link or correct conclusion. Activation: 'presumably with ReLU' is a default, 0 points, hedged, no deduction (ruling: deduct ReLU only when asserted with no hedge anywhere). 'RL policy/Q-network, or imitation' is not committed to RL, so training method 0. Rubric/brief mismatch: the rubric says 'mark the first reply only' but the brief says mark every file; every file was marked independently.
